At the presidential palace in Beirut, Lebanon’s President Joseph Aoun tells me he could see the Israeli airstrikes hitting the city. Is he powerless to stop it? “I’ll do whatever it takes,” he tells me. Israel “can destroy the whole country. They can invade the whole country. But they will never be able to achieve their objective.” @lbpresidency
